name: verinoda-live
description: Verinoda in Claude Code: keeps the code index fresh while Claude edits, checks each edit for names that do not exist, reviews commits, and shows it all in a Turkish pane with an animated mascot.

root.title: Project folder
root.description: The folder with the .verinoda index. Empty: the nearest folder at or above the one the session starts in.

cli.title: Verinoda CLI
cli.description: Path to the verinoda program. Empty: the project's .venv one if it has one, else verinoda on PATH.

python.title: Python with Verinoda
python.description: A Python that can import verinoda, to read the graph build's state. Empty: the one beside the CLI, else python on PATH.

auto.title: Code questions at start
auto.description: What a code question gets before anything is chosen with /verinoda-auto: off, nudge (the agent is asked to start with Verinoda's analyze) or search (Verinoda's results are attached). A choice made with /verinoda-auto is kept and wins.

motion.title: Animated mascot
motion.description: Let the pane's mascot blink and move. Off: it stands still.
